map.税后工资怎么算？输入应发工资、个人缴纳的五险一金与专项附加扣除，按现行个税累计预: How to compute take-home pay? Enter gross salary, personal social insurance & housing fund, and special additional deductions; the current cumulative-withholding method computes tax payable and net pay.
map.应纳税所得额 = 应发工资 − 五险一金 − 起征点 − 专项附加扣除；个税 =: Taxable income = gross salary − social insurance & housing fund − threshold − special additional deductions; tax = taxable income × rate − quick deduction
map.基于个人所得税累计预扣法：逐项扣除五险一金与专项附加扣除后按累进税率计税，得出手: Based on the personal-income-tax cumulative-withholding method: after deducting social insurance & housing fund and special additional deductions, tax is computed by progressive rates to derive net pay, for payroll estimation.
map.按累计预扣法测算个税与到手工资: Estimate tax and net pay by cumulative withholding
map.比较不同五险一金与专项附加扣除下的实发: Compare net pay under different social insurance and deduction settings
map.年度内任意月份个税税额的预估: Estimate tax for any month within the year
map.首月累计预扣：应税 10000 元 → 预扣税 790 元，到手约 20000-: First-month cumulative withholding: taxable 10,000 yuan → withholding tax 790 yuan, net ≈ 20000−3000−790 = 16,210 yuan (excluding other deductions).
map.为什么年初和年末个税不同？: Why does tax differ between early and late in the year?
map.累计预扣法下，累计所得跨入更高税率档后，后期月份的预扣税额会增加，属正常现象。: Under cumulative withholding, once cumulative income crosses into a higher bracket, later months' withholding rises—normal behavior.
map.专项附加扣除有哪些？: What are the special additional deductions?
map.子女教育、赡养老人、住房贷款利息或租金、继续教育、大病医疗、婴幼儿照护等，需据实: Child education, elderly care, housing loan interest or rent, continuing education, critical illness, infant care, etc.; declare them truthfully.
map.结果和工资条不一致？: Result differs from your pay slip?
map.基数、比例与扣除项因单位与城市而异，请以单位申报与工资条为准。: Bases, ratios and deductions vary by employer and city; defer to your employer's filing and pay slip.
map.起征点 5000 元/月，五险一金与专项附加可税前扣除: Threshold 5,000 yuan/month; social insurance and special deductions are pre-tax deductible
map.专项附加：子女教育 2000/月、房贷利息 1000/月、房租 800-1500: Special deductions: child education 2,000/month, housing-loan interest 1,000/month, rent 800–1,500/month, etc.
map.实际个税按全年累计预扣，本结果按月估算: Actual tax uses full-year cumulative withholding; this result is a monthly estimate
map.结果仅供参考，正式计算以税务部门核定为准: Results are for reference; formal calculation follows the tax authority's determination
